topic: How to Open a Brokerage Account
source_evidence: If you want someone else to have discretionary trading authority on your account, you will need to provide him or her with written legal authorization.
answer: When opening a brokerage account, you will generally make your own investment decisions. You may choose to give a broker temporary or limited discretionary authority to make decisions for your account. This requires written legal authorization, so ask your broker for the correct form. Before granting this authority, carefully consider the risks of allowing someone else to make decisions about your money.
